sessionDescription: Uploads and downloads in the terminal or SFTP panel end with the connection.
maxUploadSizeDesc: Also limits each file staged for background upload.
skipExcludedDesc: Apply the exclusion rules below to directory uploads too.
excludePatternsDesc: One pattern per line, applied to directory downloads and uploads, e.g. node_modules, .git, dist, *.log.
storageDescription: Background uploads are written to EasySSH storage first; finished background downloads produce downloadable artifacts.
storagePathDesc: Leave empty to use transfers under the runtime data directory.
maxStorageDesc: New background staging is rejected once the limit is reached.
retentionDaysDesc: Default retention for download artifacts and one-off upload staging.
transferConcurrencyDesc: Background transfers running at once. Takes effect after restart.
maxEntriesDesc: Files and directories traversed per directory download or relay.
maxDepthDesc: Deepest level traversed by directory downloads or relays.
cleanupEnabledDesc: When off, expired jobs are still marked but local files are kept.
scheduledStagingNote: SFTP upload staging for scheduled tasks is removed with the task or on replacement, regardless of retention days.
poolDescription: Recycling, health checks and per-connection concurrency for reused connections. Restart EasySSH after saving; existing connections are not interrupted.
idleTimeDesc: Connections idle this long are closed.
cleanupIntervalDesc: How often cleanup and keepalive checks run.
maxSessionsDesc: 0 means unlimited. The default of 8 is recommended.
